definition: Fortitude means strength of mind in facing danger, pain, or adversity; courage under strain.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word fortitude. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know fortitude should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: It took real fortitude for the rookie reporter to keep asking questions while the crowd jeered.
Patience is the milder quality — quietly waiting things out; fortitude adds real courage, holding steady against danger, pain, or fear.
Heroism is stronger than fortitude: it goes beyond enduring hardship bravely to taking extraordinary action at great personal risk.

Endurance is the capacity to keep going through prolonged strain — the miles, the hours, the workload. It measures how long you can last. Fortitude is different: strength of mind in the face of danger, pain, or fear, whether the ordeal lasts a month or a single minute.

Grit is scrappy toughness in the long pursuit of a goal — months of setbacks, unglamorous work, getting back up again. Fortitude is not about chasing anything: it is the courage to bear what cannot be avoided. Grit chases something; fortitude withstands something.
